items.title: Claude Opus 4.8 ships a 1M-token context window
items.summary: The latest Opus model extends usable context to one million tokens, making whole-repo reasoning and long agent runs practical without aggressive chunking. Worth revisiting your context-management code if you were paging aggressively.

items.title: Scheduled agent routines for hands-off automation
items.summary: Claude Code routines can run on a cron schedule, do research or maintenance, and open PRs autonomously — the exact pattern powering this aggregator. Good primitive for any recurring developer chore.
